title: Find 4-cycle
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2 \leq S \leq 3 \times 10^5; 2 \leq T \leq 3000; 4 \leq M \leq \min(S \times T,3 \times 10^5); 1 \leq u_i \leq S; S + 1 \leq v_i \leq S + T; If i \neq j, then (u_i, v_i) \neq (u_j, v_j).; All values in input are integers.
